details.name: Concatenating Characters of Two Strings (Case 1)
details.description: Construct a program that has a function that receives two strings and returns a string formed from the given strings such that the first character of each string is omitted.\nFor example, the new string that will be formed from the strings 'abc' and 'xyz' is 'bcyz'.\nAssume that both strings have at least one character.

details.name: Concatenating Characters of Two Strings (Case 2)
details.description: Construct a program that has a function that receives two strings and returns a string formed from the given strings separated by a space character such that the first two characters of the given strings are swapped.\nFor example, the new string that will be formed from the strings 'abc' and 'xyz' is 'xyc abz'.\nAssume that both strings have at least two characters.
